title: Population
subtitle: Understanding Demographics, Growth, and Distribution
subject: Social Science (Geography)
author: Antigravity
learning_outcomes: Understand the meaning of population density and distribution.
Analyze population growth and demographic changes.
Evaluate the qualitative aspects of population (literacy, sex ratio, life expectancy).

ai_context.learning_goal: To provide students with a comprehensive understanding of population dynamics, distribution, and the importance of human resources.
common_misconceptions: High population is always a negative factor for a country.
Population density is uniform across all states in India.
ai_context.tutor_hint: Ask the student how the geographical features of a region (like mountains vs plains) might affect where people choose to live.
